ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $AP$ is a tangent to $\odot O$, and $PB$ intersects $\odot O$ at point $C$. If point $D$ is on $\odot O$ and $\angle ADC=40^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle P$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\angle ADC=40^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ABC=40^\circ$,\\
since $AB$ is the tangent of $\odot O$ and point $A$ is the point of tangency,\\
it follows that $\angle OAB=90^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle P=90^\circ-\angle ABC=90^\circ-40^\circ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
